blocks.zh: 導言及第2節：7大品質管理原則與基本概念
blocks.en: Introduction and Clause 2: The 7 Quality Management Principles and Fundamental Concepts

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解ISO 9000在ISO 9000系列標準中的定位，以及其與ISO 9001的關係 — Understand ISO 9000's role as the conceptual foundation for ISO 9001.
blocks.en: Understand ISO 9000's role within the ISO 9000 family of standards and its relationship to ISO 9001, as the conceptual foundation for ISO 9001.

blocks.zh: 掌握6項基本概念（品質、QMS、組織環境、利益相關方、支持、能力）— Master the 6 fundamental concepts of quality management.
blocks.en: Master the 6 fundamental concepts of quality management (quality, QMS, context of the organization, interested parties, support, competence).

blocks.zh: 能逐一說明7大品質管理原則的聲明、理由、關鍵效益與可能行動 — Articulate all 7 QM Principles with statement, rationale, benefits and actions.
blocks.en: Be able to articulate each of the 7 QM principles: statement, rationale, key benefits and possible actions.

blocks.zh: 將7大原則對應至製藥/CDMO環境的具體實務 — Map each principle to pharma/CDMO practice examples.
blocks.en: Map each principle to concrete pharma/CDMO practice.

blocks.zh: 辨別「過程」(process)與「程序」(procedure)的概念差異，並理解其FDA稽查意涵 — Distinguish process from procedure and understand FDA inspection relevance.
blocks.en: Distinguish a process from a procedure and understand the relevance for FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: Foreword 前言
blocks.en: Foreword

blocks.zh: 解析 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: ISO 9000家族：三本書的分工
blocks.en: The ISO 9000 family: how the three books divide the work

blocks.zh: 可以這樣理解：
blocks.en: One way to think about it:

blocks.zh: ISO 9000 = 哲學書。告訴你「為什麼」要這樣做品質管理，定義所有重要詞彙。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 = the philosophy book. It tells you "why" quality management is done this way and defines all the key terms.

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 = 法規書。告訴你「必須」做哪些事才能通過認證。
blocks.en: ISO 9001 = the rule book. It tells you what you "must" do to be certified.

blocks.zh: ISO 9004 = 進階書。告訴你如何超越合規，達到持續卓越。
blocks.en: ISO 9004 = the advanced book. It tells you how to go beyond compliance and achieve sustained excellence.

blocks.zh: 很多人跳過ISO 9000直接讀ISO 9001，就像跳過物理學概念直接背公式——考試或許能過，但真正遇到問題時無法靈活應用。
blocks.en: Many people skip ISO 9000 and go straight to ISO 9001. That is like skipping the physics concepts and memorizing formulas: you may pass the exam, but you cannot apply the knowledge flexibly when a real problem arises.

blocks.zh: 第四版的重要升級
blocks.en: Key upgrades in the fourth edition

blocks.zh: 2015年修訂版最重要的兩個改變：
blocks.en: The two most important changes in the 2015 revision:

blocks.zh: 7大原則正式確立：從2005年的8原則精簡整合為7原則，邏輯更清晰。
blocks.en: The 7 principles were formally established: the 8 principles of 2005 were consolidated into 7, with clearer logic.

blocks.zh: Annex SL對齊：與ISO 14001、ISO 45001等管理系統標準採用相同骨架，便於企業整合稽查。製藥CDMO可以一次稽查同時驗證QMS、EHS、能源管理系統。
blocks.en: Alignment with Annex SL: the standard now shares the same high-level structure as other management system standards such as ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, which makes integrated audits easier. A pharma CDMO can have its QMS, EHS and energy management systems verified in a single audit.

blocks.zh: Introduction 導言
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: ISO 9000的核心定位：「為什麼」的哲學
blocks.en: The core positioning of ISO 9000: the philosophy of "why"

blocks.zh: ISO 9001告訴你要做什麼（What），而ISO 9000告訴你為什麼要這樣做（Why）。理解ISO 9000的人，在實施ISO 9001時能做出更好的判斷——尤其在面對標準條文語意不明時。
blocks.en: ISO 9001 tells you what to do (What), while ISO 9000 tells you why you do it (Why). People who understand ISO 9000 make better judgments when implementing ISO 9001, especially when the wording of a clause is unclear.

blocks.zh: 例如：ISO 9001要求「確定組織背景」，但不說明如何做。理解ISO 9000第2.2.3節（Context of Organization）的概念，你才知道內部因素（文化、能力）與外部因素（法規、市場）各應如何分析。
blocks.en: For example, ISO 9001 requires you to "determine the context of the organization" but does not say how. Only by understanding the concepts in ISO 9000 clause 2.2.3 (Context of Organization) do you know how to analyze internal factors (culture, competence) and external factors (regulations, market).

blocks.zh: CDMO的適用性
blocks.en: Applicability to CDMOs

blocks.zh: ISO 9000強調「適用於所有組織，不論規模、複雜度或商業模式」——這對CDMO尤其重要。CDMO同時服務多個客戶（多品項），同時接受多個法規機構（FDA、EMA、PMDA）的稽查。ISO 9000的概念框架幫助CDMO建立一套能同時滿足所有要求的思維方式，而非針對每個客戶或法規機構各自應付。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 stresses that it is "applicable to all organizations, regardless of size, complexity or business model", which matters especially for a CDMO. A CDMO serves many clients at once (multiple products) and is inspected by several regulatory agencies (FDA, EMA, PMDA) at the same time. The conceptual framework of ISO 9000 helps a CDMO build one way of thinking that satisfies all requirements together, rather than handling each client or agency separately.

blocks.zh: Clause 1: Scope 第1節：適用範圍
blocks.en: Clause 1: Scope

blocks.zh: 製藥產業對應七類使用者
blocks.en: The seven types of users in the pharmaceutical industry

blocks.zh: 製藥企業/CDMO → 尋求持續成功，建立QMS
blocks.en: Pharma companies/CDMOs → seeking sustained success and building a QMS

blocks.zh: 客戶（品牌藥廠） → 對CDMO的能力建立信心
blocks.en: Customers (brand-name pharma companies) → building confidence in the CDMO's capability

blocks.zh: CDMO對其供應商 → 供應鏈品質信心（API供應商、包材廠）
blocks.en: The CDMO toward its own suppliers → confidence in supply chain quality (API suppliers, packaging manufacturers)

blocks.zh: 跨部門溝通 → QA、生產、研發使用共同語言（什麼是「不符合」、「矯正措施」）
blocks.en: Cross-functional communication → QA, Production and R&D share a common language (what "nonconformity" and "corrective action" mean)

blocks.zh: ISO 9001稽查員 → 了解標準基礎
blocks.en: ISO 9001 auditors → understanding the foundation of the standard

blocks.zh: QA顧問/培訓師 → 教學基礎
blocks.en: QA consultants/trainers → a basis for teaching

blocks.zh: 法規機構/標準制定者 → ICH、WHO參考
blocks.en: Regulators/standard setters → reference for ICH and WHO

blocks.zh: 詞彙統一的重要性
blocks.en: Why a unified vocabulary matters

blocks.zh: 在FDA 483觀察項中，常見問題之一是不同部門對同一詞彙理解不同。例如「矯正措施」(corrective action) vs「預防措施」(preventive action)——ISO 9000在第3節提供了精確定義，確保全公司用同一語言溝通。
blocks.en: One common issue in FDA 483 observations is that different departments understand the same term differently, for example "corrective action" vs "preventive action". ISO 9000 provides precise definitions in Clause 3, so the whole company communicates in one language.

blocks.zh: 2.1–2.2: General & Fundamental Concepts 基本概念
blocks.en: 2.1–2.2: General & Fundamental Concepts

blocks.zh: 「整體性」的重要提醒
blocks.en: A reminder about "holism"

blocks.zh: ISO 9000明確警告：7大原則必須整體看待，不能只挑一兩個實施。這在製藥稽查中很常見：有些公司客戶導向做得很好（P1），但流程管理薄弱（P4），導致批次記錄異常率高。或者有強大的改善系統（P5 CAPA），但領導層不足（P2），導致改善措施無法落實。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 explicitly warns that the 7 principles must be taken as a whole; you cannot implement just one or two. This is common in pharma inspections: some companies do customer focus very well (P1) but have weak process management (P4), resulting in a high rate of batch record errors. Others have a strong improvement system (P5, CAPA) but insufficient leadership (P2), so improvement actions are never carried through.

blocks.zh: 在CDMO的環境下，知識（knowledge）確實是主要資源——製程知識、法規知識、客戶需求理解——都需要有系統地管理。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, knowledge is indeed a primary resource: process knowledge, regulatory knowledge and understanding of customer needs all need to be managed systematically.

blocks.zh: 2.2.1 Quality 品質
blocks.en: 2.2.1 Quality

blocks.zh: 品質的製藥定義延伸
blocks.en: Extending the definition of quality to pharma

blocks.zh: 注意「intended and unintended impact」——製藥領域，unintended impact包含：副作用風險、交叉污染、環境影響。ICH Q8/Q9/Q10框架中的「Quality by Design」正是回應這個要求：在設計階段就預見所有潛在影響，而非靠終端測試發現問題。
blocks.en: Note the phrase "intended and unintended impact". In pharma, unintended impact includes side-effect risk, cross-contamination and environmental impact. "Quality by Design" in the ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 framework is a direct response to this requirement: anticipate all potential impacts at the design stage, rather than discovering problems through end-product testing.

blocks.zh: 「perceived value」在CDMO語境下：客戶付錢買的不只是合格的批次，還有批次記錄的清晰度、溝通的即時性、供貨的穩定性——這些都是「感知價值」。
blocks.en: "Perceived value" in a CDMO context: what the customer pays for is not only a conforming batch but also the clarity of the batch record, the timeliness of communication and the reliability of supply. All of these are "perceived value".

blocks.zh: 2.2.2 Quality Management System (QMS) 品質管理系統
blocks.en: 2.2.2 Quality Management System (QMS)

blocks.zh: QMS ≠ 文件系統
blocks.en: QMS ≠ document system

blocks.zh: 很多人把QMS等同於SOP文件庫——這是最常見的誤解。ISO 9000說得很清楚：QMS是「識別目標、決定過程與資源以達成結果」的活動集合。文件是支撐QMS的工具，不是QMS本身。
blocks.en: Many people equate the QMS with a library of SOPs, which is the most common misunderstanding. ISO 9000 is very clear: a QMS is a set of activities for "identifying objectives and determining the processes and resources required to achieve the desired results". Documents are tools that support the QMS; they are not the QMS itself.

blocks.zh: 在CDMO：一個有效的QMS讓管理層能夠決定：哪條生產線優先排程、哪個供應商值得長期合作、哪個改善項目優先投資——這些都是QMS對資源優化的具體表現。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, an effective QMS lets management decide which production line to schedule first, which supplier merits a long-term partnership and which improvement project to invest in first. These are all concrete expressions of the QMS optimizing resources.

blocks.zh: 2.2.3 Context of an Organization 組織環境
blocks.en: 2.2.3 Context of an Organization

blocks.zh: CDMO的組織環境分析（SWOT對應）
blocks.en: Analyzing the CDMO's context (mapped to SWOT)

blocks.zh: 內部因素： 現有設施能力（無菌灌裝線數量）、人員能力水準、現有QMS成熟度、企業文化（是否鼓勵問題通報）。
blocks.en: Internal factors: existing facility capability (number of aseptic filling lines), staff competence, maturity of the existing QMS, corporate culture (whether problem reporting is encouraged).

blocks.zh: 外部因素： FDA 21 CFR 210/211法規要求、EMA GMP指引、客戶合約規定、競爭對手的技術能力、原材料市場供應穩定性。
blocks.en: External factors: FDA 21 CFR 210/211 requirements, EMA GMP guidelines, customer contract terms, competitors' technical capabilities, stability of raw material supply.

blocks.zh: 這對應ISO 9001:2015的第4.1條——理解ISO 9000的概念，才能更有意義地完成這個分析，而非只是填一張SWOT表格應付稽查員。
blocks.en: This corresponds to clause 4.1 of ISO 9001:2015. Understanding the ISO 9000 concepts lets you carry out this analysis meaningfully, rather than just filling in a SWOT table to satisfy the auditor.

blocks.zh: 2.2.4 Interested Parties 利益相關方
blocks.en: 2.2.4 Interested Parties

blocks.zh: CDMO的利益相關方全圖
blocks.en: The full picture of a CDMO's interested parties

blocks.zh: 客戶（品牌藥廠）：需要合規、準時、符合成本的製造服務
blocks.en: Customers (brand-name pharma companies): need compliant, on-time, cost-effective manufacturing services

blocks.zh: 法規機構（FDA、EMA、PMDA）：需要GMP合規
blocks.en: Regulators (FDA, EMA, PMDA): require GMP compliance

blocks.zh: 最終患者：需要安全有效的藥品
blocks.en: End patients: need safe and effective medicines

blocks.zh: 員工：需要安全工作環境與職業發展
blocks.en: Employees: need a safe working environment and career development

blocks.zh: 供應商：需要公平合約與穩定採購
blocks.en: Suppliers: need fair contracts and stable purchasing

blocks.zh: 股東/投資人：需要財務回報與聲譽維護
blocks.en: Shareholders/investors: need financial returns and a protected reputation

blocks.zh: 社區/環境：需要負責任的廢棄物管理
blocks.en: Community/environment: need responsible waste management

blocks.zh: 並非所有利益相關方同等重要——ISO 9000的關鍵詞是「relevant」（相關的）。組織需判斷哪些方的需求若不滿足，將對可持續性造成重大風險。
blocks.en: Not all interested parties are equally important. The key word in ISO 9000 is "relevant". The organization must judge which parties' needs, if unmet, would pose a significant risk to its sustainability.

blocks.zh: 2.2.5 Support 支持
blocks.en: 2.2.5 Support

blocks.zh: 「支持」是QMS的基礎建設
blocks.en: "Support" is the infrastructure of the QMS

blocks.zh: 這5個子概念（資源、人員、能力、意識、溝通）在ISO 9001:2015第7節中都有對應要求。理解這些概念的邏輯鏈：
blocks.en: These 5 sub-concepts (resources, people, competence, awareness, communication) all have corresponding requirements in clause 7 of ISO 9001:2015. The logical chain behind them:

blocks.zh: Top management提供資源 → 選擇具備能力的人員 → 建立意識（知道自己工作的意義）→ 透過溝通保持對齊。
blocks.en: Top management provides resources → selects people with the right competence → builds awareness (knowing why their work matters) → keeps everyone aligned through communication.

blocks.zh: 在製藥CDMO的稽查觀察中，「能力」(competence)的定義至關重要：FDA期望看到education + training + experience的完整組合，而非只有完成訓練記錄。能力要有「驗證」，例如操作員實際執行無菌技術的評估記錄。
blocks.en: In pharma CDMO inspection observations, the definition of "competence" is critical: the FDA expects to see the full combination of education + training + experience, not just completed training records. Competence must be "verified", for example through assessment records of an operator actually performing aseptic technique.

blocks.zh: 意識 vs 訓練：關鍵差異
blocks.en: Awareness vs training: the key difference

blocks.zh: 很多組織混淆「完成訓練」與「建立意識」。ISO 9000的定義是：意識=理解自己的責任+知道自己的行為如何影響組織目標。完成訓練簽名不代表有意識。一個無菌填充操作員若不理解為什麼要做LVP（低風險行為訓練），其操作風險就高。
blocks.en: Many organizations confuse "completed training" with "established awareness". ISO 9000 defines awareness as understanding your responsibilities + knowing how your actions affect the organization's objectives. A signed training record does not mean awareness. An aseptic filling operator who does not understand why LVP (low-risk behavior training) is done carries a high operating risk.

blocks.zh: 2.3 Quality Management Principles — Overview 品質管理原則概覽
blocks.en: 2.3 Quality Management Principles — Overview

blocks.zh: 為什麼從8原則精簡到7原則？
blocks.en: Why were the 8 principles reduced to 7?

blocks.zh: ISO 9000:2005有8大原則。2015年修訂時，「系統方法管理」(System approach to management) 被合併進「過程方法」(Process approach)，因為兩者概念高度重疊。這體現了ISO 9000的整體觀：組織是一個相互關聯的系統，過程方法本身就是系統思維的體現。
blocks.en: ISO 9000:2005 had 8 principles. In the 2015 revision, "System approach to management" was merged into the "Process approach" because the two concepts overlap heavily. This reflects the holistic view of ISO 9000: an organization is an interrelated system, and the process approach is itself an expression of systems thinking.

blocks.zh: PDCA與ICH Q10的關係
blocks.en: The relationship between PDCA and ICH Q10

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System（製藥品質系統）在結構上與PDCA高度對應：
blocks.en: The structure of ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System closely corresponds to PDCA:

blocks.zh: 理解PDCA讓你看懂ICH Q10的底層邏輯，而非把它當作另一堆合規要求。
blocks.en: Understanding PDCA lets you see the underlying logic of ICH Q10, instead of treating it as yet another pile of compliance requirements.

blocks.zh: 風險思維：不是獨立工具，是思維方式
blocks.en: Risk-based thinking: a way of thinking, not a stand-alone tool

blocks.zh: ISO 9000明確說明：風險思維不是一個獨立的過程或工具（不像FMEA那樣的獨立方法），而是貫穿於整個管理系統的思維方式。每個決策、每個過程設計都應該包含「如果出問題會怎樣」的考量。這與ICH Q9（品質風險管理）的精神完全一致。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 states explicitly that risk-based thinking is not a separate process or tool (unlike a stand-alone method such as FMEA), but a way of thinking that runs through the entire management system. Every decision and every process design should include the question "what happens if something goes wrong?". This is fully consistent with the spirit of ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management).

blocks.zh: 2.3.1 Customer Focus 顧客導向
blocks.en: 2.3.1 Customer Focus

blocks.zh: 顧客導向
blocks.en: Customer Focus

blocks.zh: CDMO的顧客導向：患者是最終顧客
blocks.en: Customer focus in a CDMO: the patient is the ultimate customer

blocks.zh: CDMO的直接客戶是品牌藥廠，但間接客戶是最終患者。ISO 9000對「顧客」的定義包含direct（直接）和indirect（間接）——這意味著CDMO在做決策時必須考慮最終患者安全，而非只滿足品牌藥廠的商業需求。
blocks.en: A CDMO's direct customer is the brand-name pharma company, but its indirect customer is the end patient. ISO 9000's definition of "customer" includes both direct and indirect customers, which means a CDMO must consider end-patient safety in its decisions, not just satisfy the commercial needs of the brand-name company.

blocks.zh: 實例：品牌藥廠可能要求縮短交期，但若這會影響批次品質，CDMO有責任以患者安全為由提出異議。這就是「顧客導向」的真正意涵——超越眼前交易，建立長期信任。
blocks.en: Example: a brand-name company may ask for a shorter lead time, but if this would affect batch quality, the CDMO has a responsibility to object on patient-safety grounds. This is the real meaning of "customer focus": going beyond the immediate transaction to build long-term trust.

blocks.zh: 「超越期望」的製藥解讀
blocks.en: "Exceeding expectations" in pharma terms

blocks.zh: 在製藥CDMO，超越客戶期望的具體表現：
blocks.en: In a pharma CDMO, exceeding customer expectations looks like this:

blocks.zh: 主動預警原材料供應風險（而非等客戶問）
blocks.en: Proactively warning of raw material supply risks (rather than waiting for the customer to ask)

blocks.zh: 批次記錄品質超過最低要求（清晰度、完整性）
blocks.en: Batch record quality that exceeds the minimum requirements (clarity, completeness)

blocks.zh: 提供製程優化建議（而非只執行客戶的規格）
blocks.en: Offering process optimization suggestions (rather than just executing the customer's specifications)

blocks.zh: 出現偏差時主動溝通，不等客戶發現
blocks.en: Communicating proactively when a deviation occurs, without waiting for the customer to find out

blocks.zh: 常見失敗模式
blocks.en: Common failure modes

blocks.zh: 組織只看短期業績KPI（今季出貨量），忽略長期客戶關係管理。在製藥，這等同於：只看批次通過率，不看客戶對整體服務品質的滿意度——導致合約不續簽。
blocks.en: The organization looks only at short-term KPIs (this quarter's shipments) and neglects long-term customer relationship management. In pharma, this is equivalent to looking only at the batch pass rate and not at the customer's satisfaction with overall service quality, which leads to contracts not being renewed.

blocks.zh: 2.3.2 Leadership 領導力
blocks.en: 2.3.2 Leadership

blocks.zh: 領導力
blocks.en: Leadership

blocks.zh: QP（合格人士）制度：領導力的法規化體現
blocks.en: The QP (Qualified Person) system: leadership codified in regulation

blocks.zh: 歐盟GMP框架中，Qualified Person（QP）是代表最高管理層對每批藥品品質做出認證的關鍵角色。這完美體現了「領導力」原則——QP的權威不可被商業壓力凌駕，這需要高層真正建立「品質文化」，而非只是名義上的承諾。
blocks.en: In the EU GMP framework, the Qualified Person (QP) is the key role who certifies the quality of each batch of medicine on behalf of top management. This is a perfect illustration of the "leadership" principle: the QP's authority must not be overridden by commercial pressure, and that requires top management to genuinely build a "quality culture" rather than offering only nominal commitment.

blocks.zh: 若高層只在稽查時才表現重視品質，員工就會學習「稽查模式」——平時走捷徑，稽查前才趕緊補文件。這正是領導力失效的典型表現。
blocks.en: If top management shows concern for quality only at inspection time, employees learn an "inspection mode": cutting corners day to day and rushing to patch up documents just before an inspection. This is a classic sign of failed leadership.

blocks.zh: 「各級別領導」的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of "leaders at all levels"

blocks.zh: ISO 9000強調「leaders at all levels」——不只是CEO或QA總監，還包括現場主管、班長。在無菌填充操作中，現場主管（班長）的行為直接影響操作員是否願意通報潛在問題。如果班長文化是「能過就過」，再好的QMS文件都是空話。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 emphasizes "leaders at all levels", which means not only the CEO or QA head but also floor supervisors and team leaders. In aseptic filling operations, the behavior of the floor supervisor (team leader) directly affects whether operators are willing to report potential problems. If the team-leader culture is "pass it if you can get away with it", even the best QMS documents are empty words.

blocks.zh: 2.3.3 Engagement of People 人員參與
blocks.en: 2.3.3 Engagement of People

blocks.zh: 人員參與
blocks.en: Engagement of People

blocks.zh: 跨職能團隊：人員參與的最佳實踐
blocks.en: Cross-functional teams: best practice for engaging people

blocks.zh: 在製藥CDMO，人員參與的最高形式是有效的跨職能團隊：QA、生產、研發、供應鏈共同處理偏差調查、CAPA設計、新產品導入。若每個部門只各自為政，問題的根本原因往往找不到（例如：生產說是設備問題，QC說是原料問題，QA說是SOP問題——只有跨部門合作才能找到真正原因）。
blocks.en: In a pharma CDMO, the highest form of engagement is an effective cross-functional team: QA, Production, R&D and Supply Chain working together on deviation investigations, CAPA design and new product introduction. If each department works in isolation, the root cause is often never found (for example: Production says it is an equipment problem, QC says it is a raw material problem and QA says it is an SOP problem; only cross-department collaboration can find the true cause).

blocks.zh: 「無懼環境」(without fear) 的關鍵性
blocks.en: Why "without fear" is critical

blocks.zh: ISO 9000特別提到empowering people to take initiatives without fear。這對應FDA的「品質文化」概念：員工若害怕通報問題會被責罰，就會選擇沉默——導致小問題變成大事故。ISO 9000把這個心理安全環境定義為品質管理的核心，而非只是HR議題。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 specifically mentions empowering people to take initiatives without fear. This corresponds to the FDA concept of "quality culture": if employees fear punishment for reporting problems, they stay silent, and small problems become major incidents. ISO 9000 treats this psychologically safe environment as a core element of quality management, not merely an HR issue.

blocks.zh: 2.3.4 Process Approach 過程方法
blocks.en: 2.3.4 Process Approach

blocks.zh: 過程方法
blocks.en: Process Approach

blocks.zh: Process vs. Procedure — FDA稽查中的關鍵區別
blocks.en: Process vs. Procedure: a key distinction in FDA inspections

blocks.zh: Procedure（程序）：描述「如何做某件事」的文件指引（SOP）。
blocks.en: Procedure: a documented instruction describing "how to do something" (an SOP).

blocks.zh: Process（過程）：將輸入轉化為輸出的一組相互關聯的活動，包含其輸入、輸出、資源、控制點、績效指標。
blocks.en: Process: a set of interrelated activities that transform inputs into outputs, including its inputs, outputs, resources, control points and performance indicators.

blocks.zh: FDA 483常見觀察：「操作員依照SOP操作，但仍發生問題」——原因往往是SOP（procedure）正確，但過程設計（process design）有缺陷，例如輸入材料的品質控制點不足，或過程之間的交接介面定義不清楚。
blocks.en: A common FDA 483 observation: "the operator followed the SOP, yet problems still occurred". The cause is often that the SOP (procedure) is correct but the process design has a flaw, for example insufficient quality control points for input materials, or poorly defined interfaces for handover between processes.

blocks.zh: ISO 9000的「過程方法」要求你理解過程，不只是遵循程序。
blocks.en: The "process approach" of ISO 9000 requires you to understand the process, not just follow the procedure.

blocks.zh: ICH Q10：製藥品質系統 = 過程方法的最佳實踐
blocks.en: ICH Q10: the pharmaceutical quality system as the best practice of the process approach

blocks.zh:
ICH Q10定義的四個主要過程：
(1) 過程績效與產品品質監控系統
(2) 矯正措施與預防措施系統（CAPA）
(3) 變更管理系統
(4) 管理審查
blocks.en:
The four main processes defined by ICH Q10:
(1) Process performance and product quality monitoring system
(2) Corrective action and preventive action (CAPA) system
(3) Change management system
(4) Management review

blocks.zh: 這四個過程相互關聯：監控系統發現問題→觸發CAPA→CAPA可能引發變更→變更在管理審查中評估。理解過程間的輸入輸出關係，才能設計有效的QMS。
blocks.en: These four processes are interrelated: the monitoring system detects a problem → triggers CAPA → CAPA may lead to a change → the change is evaluated in management review. Only by understanding the input-output relationships between processes can you design an effective QMS.

blocks.zh: 2.3.5 Improvement 改善
blocks.en: 2.3.5 Improvement

blocks.zh: 改善
blocks.en: Improvement

blocks.zh: CAPA系統：改善原則的法規實踐
blocks.en: The CAPA system: the regulatory practice of the improvement principle

blocks.zh: Corrective Action and Preventive Action（CAPA）是製藥GMP對「改善」原則的法規化要求。21 CFR 820.100（美國QSR）和EU GMP第1章均要求有效的CAPA系統。
blocks.en: Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) is the regulatory requirement in pharma GMP that embodies the "improvement" principle. Both 21 CFR 820.100 (US QSR) and EU GMP Chapter 1 require an effective CAPA system.

blocks.zh:
ISO 9000強調兩類改善：
Incremental（漸進式）：CAPA處理偏差，持續降低不符合率
Breakthrough（突破式）：製程重新設計、PAT（製程分析技術）導入
blocks.en:
ISO 9000 emphasizes two types of improvement:
Incremental: CAPA addresses deviations and continuously lowers the nonconformity rate
Breakthrough: process redesign and the introduction of PAT (process analytical technology)

blocks.zh: 只有漸進式改善而無突破性創新，組織最終會停滯。只追求突破而不做好日常改善，基礎不穩。兩者必須平衡。
blocks.en: With only incremental improvement and no breakthrough innovation, an organization eventually stagnates. If it pursues only breakthroughs and neglects day-to-day improvement, its foundation is unstable. The two must be balanced.

blocks.zh: 「改善」的最大陷阱：CAPA的形式化
blocks.en: The biggest trap of "improvement": formalistic CAPA

blocks.zh: 在許多製藥公司，CAPA系統變成「關閉偏差記錄」的工具，而非真正改善的引擎。常見徵兆：CAPA的根本原因分析只寫「人員訓練不足」，改善措施只有「重新訓練」——下次同類問題照樣發生。真正的改善需要系統性根因分析（5 Whys, Fishbone），而非症狀處理。
blocks.en: In many pharma companies, the CAPA system becomes a tool for "closing deviation records" rather than a real engine of improvement. Common signs: the root cause analysis in the CAPA says only "insufficient staff training" and the corrective action is only "retraining", so the same type of problem recurs next time. Real improvement requires systematic root cause analysis (5 Whys, Fishbone), not treatment of symptoms.

blocks.zh: 2.3.6 Evidence-Based Decision Making 以事實為基礎的決策
blocks.en: 2.3.6 Evidence-Based Decision Making

blocks.zh: 以事實為基礎的決策
blocks.en: Evidence-Based Decision Making

blocks.zh: OOS調查：以事實決策的最高要求
blocks.en: OOS investigations: the highest standard of evidence-based decisions

blocks.zh: Out-of-Specification（OOS）調查是製藥以事實決策最典型的應用。FDA Guidance for Industry (OOS, 2006) 要求：所有OOS結果必須完整調查，不能因為「可能是實驗室錯誤」就直接拒絕結果（invalidation必須有充分科學依據）。
blocks.en: Out-of-Specification (OOS) investigation is the most typical application of evidence-based decision making in pharma. The FDA Guidance for Industry (OOS, 2006) requires that all OOS results be fully investigated and not simply rejected because they "may be a laboratory error" (invalidation must have sufficient scientific justification).

blocks.zh: 每個拒批或放行決定，都必須有數據支撐，不能依賴「感覺這批應該沒問題」的直覺。
blocks.en: Every decision to reject or release a batch must be backed by data; it cannot rest on the gut feeling that "this batch should be fine".

blocks.zh: 重要：「平衡經驗與直覺」
blocks.en: Important: "balanced with experience and intuition"

blocks.zh: ISO 9000特別提到決策要「balanced with experience and intuition」——這不是說直覺比數據重要，而是承認人類判斷在複雜決策中的作用。在製藥，資深QA的「直覺」（基於多年經驗的模式識別）可以在數據不完整時幫助識別問題，但最終決策仍需數據支持。ISO 9000在此提供了更現實的平衡觀點，而非單純的「data-only」主義。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 specifically says decisions should be "balanced with experience and intuition". This does not mean intuition matters more than data; it acknowledges the role of human judgment in complex decisions. In pharma, the "intuition" of a senior QA person (pattern recognition built on years of experience) can help identify problems when data are incomplete, but the final decision still needs data support. ISO 9000 offers a more realistic balance here than a pure "data-only" stance.

blocks.zh: 數據品質的前提
blocks.en: The prerequisite: data quality

blocks.zh: 以事實決策的前提是「data integrity」（資料完整性）——ALCOA+ 原則（Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, plus Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available）。若原始數據有問題，所有基於數據的決策都是建立在沙上的城堡。這也是FDA近年對數據完整性稽查力度顯著加強的背景。
blocks.en: The prerequisite for evidence-based decisions is "data integrity", meaning the ALCOA+ principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, plus Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available). If the original data are flawed, every decision based on them is a castle built on sand. This is also why the FDA has significantly stepped up data integrity inspections in recent years.

blocks.zh: 2.3.7 Relationship Management 關係管理
blocks.en: 2.3.7 Relationship Management

blocks.zh: 關係管理
blocks.en: Relationship Management

blocks.zh: 供應商資格審查計畫：關係管理的法規實踐
blocks.en: Supplier qualification program: the regulatory practice of relationship management

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR 211.68/211.80 以及EU GMP第5章均要求組織對供應商進行資格確認和定期評估。這不只是「挑最便宜的供應商」，而是建立長期戰略夥伴關係：
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR 211.68/211.80 and EU GMP Chapter 5 both require organizations to qualify suppliers and evaluate them periodically. This is not about "picking the cheapest supplier" but about building long-term strategic partnerships:

blocks.zh: 初始資格：稽查、問卷、樣品測試
blocks.en: Initial qualification: audit, questionnaire, sample testing

blocks.zh: 持續評估：定期再稽查、批次品質數據分析
blocks.en: Ongoing evaluation: periodic re-audits and analysis of batch quality data

blocks.zh: 改善合作：與供應商共同解決品質問題（聯合CAPA）
blocks.en: Collaborative improvement: solving quality problems together with the supplier (joint CAPA)

blocks.zh: 長期vs短期：不因短期成本壓力輕易更換已驗證的優質供應商
blocks.en: Long-term vs short-term: not readily replacing a proven, high-quality supplier because of short-term cost pressure

blocks.zh: CDMO雙重身份的特殊性
blocks.en: The CDMO's dual role

blocks.zh:
CDMO在關係管理上有雙重身份：
對上游供應商（API廠、包材廠）是客戶 → 需要評估和管理供應商關係
對下游品牌藥廠是服務提供者 → 需要維護客戶關係
blocks.en:
A CDMO has a dual role in relationship management:
toward upstream suppliers (API manufacturers, packaging manufacturers) it is the customer → it must evaluate and manage the supplier relationship
toward downstream brand-name companies it is the service provider → it must maintain the customer relationship

blocks.zh: 這兩個方向的關係管理都必須做好，才能保證整個供應鏈的品質穩定。任何一個環節的關係管理失效，都會影響最終患者收到的藥品品質。
blocks.en: Relationship management must be done well in both directions to keep quality stable across the whole supply chain. A failure of relationship management at any link will affect the quality of the medicine the end patient receives.

blocks.zh: 2.4 Developing the QMS 發展品質管理系統
blocks.en: 2.4 Developing the QMS

blocks.zh: 「活的有機體」比喻
blocks.en: The "living organism" metaphor

blocks.zh: ISO 9000將組織比作「living and learning social organism」——這個比喻深刻：就像生物體會適應環境，組織的QMS也必須隨內外部環境變化而調整。僵化、一成不變的QMS會像不能適應環境的物種一樣被淘汰。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 compares an organization to a "living and learning social organism". This is a profound metaphor: just as organisms adapt to their environment, an organization's QMS must also adjust as internal and external conditions change. A rigid, unchanging QMS will be eliminated like a species that cannot adapt to its environment.

blocks.zh: 製藥CDMO的QMS必須能夠快速適應：新客戶的要求、新法規的實施、新技術的導入、疫情等突發事件——同時保持核心品質控制不動搖。
blocks.en: A pharma CDMO's QMS must be able to adapt quickly to new customer requirements, newly implemented regulations, newly introduced technologies and sudden events such as pandemics, while keeping its core quality controls firmly in place.

blocks.zh: 「不複雜但準確反映需求」
blocks.en: "Not complex, but accurately reflecting needs"

blocks.zh: 這句話對中小型CDMO非常重要。很多公司誤以為QMS越複雜、SOP越多就越好。ISO 9000明確說：QMS不需要複雜，只需要準確反映組織的真實需求和運作方式。過度複雜的QMS反而讓員工無法遵從，增加不符合的風險。
blocks.en: This statement is very important for small and mid-sized CDMOs. Many companies wrongly believe that the more complex the QMS and the more SOPs, the better. ISO 9000 states clearly that a QMS does not need to be complex; it only needs to accurately reflect the organization's real needs and way of operating. An overly complex QMS makes it impossible for staff to comply and increases the risk of nonconformity.

blocks.zh: 整合管理系統（IMS）的效益
blocks.en: Benefits of an integrated management system (IMS)

blocks.zh: 對製藥CDMO，整合ISO 9001（品質）+ ISO 14001（環境）+ ISO 45001（職安衛）的實際效益：
blocks.en: The practical benefits for a pharma CDMO of integrating ISO 9001 (quality) + ISO 14001 (environment) + ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety):

blocks.zh: 一套稽查而非三套稽查，節省時間與成本
blocks.en: One audit instead of three, saving time and cost

blocks.zh: 同一支持系統（文件管理、訓練、內部稽查）服務多個標準
blocks.en: The same support systems (document control, training, internal audit) serve multiple standards

blocks.zh: 避免各系統之間的矛盾和重複
blocks.en: Avoids contradictions and duplication between systems

blocks.zh: 向客戶和法規機構展示系統性的管理能力
blocks.en: Demonstrates systematic management capability to customers and regulators

blocks.zh: 稽查的真正目的
blocks.en: The real purpose of auditing

blocks.zh: ISO 9000說稽查是「評估QMS有效性、識別風險、確定要求履行」的手段——不是懲罰工具，不是形式性合規檢查。有效的內部稽查應該是QMS改善的驅動力，發現問題是好事，代表系統正在正常運作。這個思維轉變對建立健康的品質文化至關重要。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 describes auditing as a means of "evaluating the effectiveness of the QMS, identifying risks and determining that requirements are fulfilled". It is not a punishment tool or a box-ticking compliance check. An effective internal audit should be a driver of QMS improvement; finding problems is a good thing, because it shows the system is working as it should. This shift in mindset is essential for building a healthy quality culture.

blocks.zh: Summary: 7 Principles × Pharma Application 7大原則製藥對照表
blocks.en: Summary: 7 Principles × Pharma Application

blocks.zh: Reflection Exercise 思考練習
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise

blocks.zh: 在你的組織中，7大原則各自的成熟度如何？請對每個原則評分（1=剛起步，5=業界典範），並找出最薄弱的兩個原則作為下一階段改善重點。
blocks.en: How mature is each of the 7 principles in your organization? Score each principle (1 = just starting, 5 = industry exemplar) and identify the two weakest principles as the improvement focus for the next stage.
